pages.text: 滴答滴答，下雨啦！朱迪穿上雨衣和雨靴，出门巡逻。
pages.kw: Judy Hopps in raincoat, rainy street, puddles

pages.text: 小蜗牛慢慢爬，雨点打在身上。朱迪轻轻把它移到树叶下。
pages.kw: Judy helping snail under leaf, rainy garden

pages.text: 小兔子迷路了，害怕得直哭。朱迪撑着伞，送它回家。
pages.kw: Judy holding umbrella, walking with a lost bunny in rain

pages.text: 哎呀，路上有个大水坑！朱迪搬来树枝，盖住水坑，保护大家。
pages.kw: Judy covering a big puddle with branches, rainy path

pages.text: 雨停了，彩虹出来了！小动物们笑着对朱迪说谢谢。
pages.kw: rainbow after rain, Judy waving, happy animals

pages.text: 朱迪开心地敬个礼：“明天继续巡逻，帮助大家！”
pages.kw: Judy saluting with smile, sunny day after rain
